title: EXCLUSIVE: Ipsy Wants In on Wellness
summary: The beauty box subscription service is introducing a curated wellness offering for the first time featuring a slate of supplement brands.

extraction.key_fact: 뷰티 박스 구독 서비스인 입시가 여러 보충제 브랜드를 포함한 큐레이션 웰니스 서비스를 처음으로 선보인다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The beauty box subscription service is introducing a curated wellness offering for the first time featuring a slate of supplement brands.
